description: This file defines a router with several commands related to fixed income spreads, specifically for treasury-related data. It includes command handlers for Treasury Constant Maturity, Selected Treasury Constant Maturity, and Treasury Bill data retrievals.

methods.name: OBBject tcm( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves data for 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Minus Selected Treasury Constant Maturity based on provided provider.

methods.name: OBBject tcm_effr( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves data for Selected Treasury Constant Maturity Minus Federal Funds Rate based on provided provider.

methods.name: OBBject treasury_effr( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
methods.description: Retrieves data for Selected Treasury Bill Minus Federal Funds Rate based on provided provider.
